text: Worn Leather Strap is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wounds are props found at the Star Lake Amphitheater during The Fourth Wall, er, War. They represent Azeroth's wounds as a result of her impalement by the Sword of Sargeras.

Wormhole Generators can be used to travel around a continent or to a specific place. *Wormhole Generator: Northrend *Wormhole Generator: Pandaria *Wormhole Generator: Argus *Wormhole Generator: Shadowlands * Wyrmhole Generator: Dragon Isles Other types of wormhole generators: *Ultrasafe Transporter: Gadgetzan *Dimensional Ripper - Everlook *Ultrasafe Transporter: Toshley's Station *Dimensional Ripper - Area 52 *Wormhole Centrifuge (Draenor) *Ultrasafe Transporter: Mechagon
Teleports the caster to a location in Northrend (of a fixed set of locations) with 4 hr Cooldown.

.]] The demonic wrathguard (or wrathguards) are members of the man'ari eredar species loyal to the Burning Legion. Cunning and precise, the wrathguard often protect the Legion's leaders as honor guard. Their skill in battle should never be underestimated. Elite front-line troops, they are often seen wielding two weapons with equal measure. They have long tails, digitigrade legs, a double set of horns, and a formidable suit of armor. The key to binding a wrathguard is ironically reducing the number of runic symbols used in the summoning circle. Wrathguard are highly resistant to charms and compulsions, but readily respond to basic expressions of strength.
Wrecked Demolisher is a destroyed demolisher found in Icecrown.

Wrathful Gladiator's Frost Wyrm is a Feat of Strength for acquiring a Wrathful Gladiator's Frost Wyrm mount, which was awarded to all arena teams in the top 0.5% of their battlegroup at the end of Season 8.

The Wreckage of the Silver Dawning is one of several sunken frigates off the northern coast of Darkshore. It was attacked and sunk by murlocs as it was approaching Auberdine after having crossed the Great Sea. Some of the crew survived by swimming ashore, but the captain went down with the ship. Silver Dawning lies just south of Mist Veil. The quest An Ocean Not So Deep takes place here.

The Wreck of the Skyseeker is where the Alliance gunship Skyseeker crashed into the Wandering Isle after having captured Horde prisoners from a naval battle. Delora Lionheart is the current captain of the survivors of the crew, which settled at an unnamed triage camp near the wreckage. The crash caused a great wound in the side of Shen-zin Su, the creature that is the Wandering Isle, making him unable to swim straight. The wreck was eventually destroyed by the combined efforts of the Alliance and Horde, which again worked together to heal the gaping wound left behind by the removal. Druids and priests even grew back some of the trees that were there before.
The Wrecked Caravan was a caravan headed into to the new commander's outpost, but was destroyed by a ambush from Anguish Point.
Wrathguard Soulsplitters are wrathguard found in Suramar City in Suramar.

Wrathion, the Black Emperor is the first boss of Ny'alotha, the Waking City. The boss fight is not truly against Wrathion himself, but rather a faceless one named Ki'merax disguised as a corrupted version of the Black Prince. Ki'merax's true form is revealed upon "Wrathion's" defeat.

The Wreath of Night's Veil Flowers is found at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald. The flowers are used in ceremonies of the fae, but since the drought they've just used them as props in their plays.

The Wrath of Xandria is a projection of the Paragon of Courage that can be summoned with the bonus ability during the quests Death Rains, No Hesitation, No Surrender, and Peace by Piece at the Temple of Courage in Bastion. Upon being summoned, the wrath leaps to the targeted location and deals heavy damage to all nearby enemy Necrolords: : She then immediately flies off and disappears again.
__NOTOC__ Wrath of Dargrul is a earth fury located in Highmountain.
Wrecking Throw is a row 5 warrior class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Shattering Throw.
Wristguards of Stability are a pair of Level 60 Leather Wristguards that improve Agility and Stamina.

__NOTOC__ The Wyrmbog is the area in the south of Dustwallow Marsh, south of the Dragonmurk. Many dragons of the black dragonflight, including Onyxia and Emberstrife, reside here. The entrances to Emberstrife's Den and Onyxia's Lair are located within this bog.

]] The Writhing Haunt is an area located in the central part of the Western Plaguelands, just east of the Ruins of Andorhal. Originally the area was a life-sustaining farm, but it has since been overrun by the vile Scourge. In their quest to destroy the living, they have placed a large cauldron in the middle of the field which constantly spews disease-filled vapors into the air. The cauldron itself is protected by Cauldron Lord Razarch, Rotting Ghouls, Freezing Ghouls, and Fetid Zombies. You can find Mulgris Deepriver, a quest giving NPC, hidden inside a house at the Writhing Haunt.

Wrecthed Urchins are wretched found in the Ruins of Silvermoon in Eversong Woods. They are becoming an increasing threat to the denizens of Falconwing Square, especially for the Outrunners. These wretched are led by Thaelis the Hungerer.

Wyrmrest Temple Drakes are elite red drake guards for Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight. A mount version is summoned by the Summon Dragon Flight extra button for low-level players doing Legion questlines in Northrend.
__NOTOC__ Wyrmrest Defender is a red dragon found on the second level of the Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight. The defenders are mounted by adventurers to kill the attacking blue dragonflight.
Wrynn's Leggings of Foresight are a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance).
Wrynn's Leggings of Valor are a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance).
Wrynn's Leggings of Wisdom are a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance).
Wrynn's Legguards of Brutality are a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance).
Wrynn's Legplates of Carnage are a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance).
Wrynn's Legguards of Heroism are a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity (Alliance).
Wyrmrest Necklace of Power is an epic necklace for DPS casters.

__NOTOC__ Wyrm Reanimators are humans located at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising. Occasionally, a Frostbrood Spawn takes them into their mouth and flies away.
__NOTOC__ Wulf Hansreim is a human hunter trainer and quest giver found in the Command Center in Stormwind City. He oversees the training and coordination of hunters in the service of Stormwind.
__NOTOC__ Wright Williams is a human located in the Five Deadly Venoms in the Old Town of Stormwind City. He works for Miles Sidney.
Writing the Future is a monthly quest that can be completed during Darkmoon Faire. You must have 75 inscription skill to complete.

Wu-Song Village is a small pandaren village located in the northern area of the Wandering Isle. This village is split by a small river that runs from the nearby mountains. The village is populated by Wu-Song Villagers and is currently being ransacked by the hozen, who are attempting to make off with its supplies.
Wyrmtongue Harvesters are wyrmtongues that appears in the Ruins of Southshore during the Legion Invasion. They can be seen taking samples from the blight in the city.
Wretched Looters are wyrmtongues located in Val'sharah, Azsuna, Highmountain, and Stormheim during Legion Assaults.
Wyna Breezehorn is a Highmountain tauren located in Stonetusk Watch in Stormsong Valley.
Wyvern Hatchet Toss is a Survival hunter ability. This spell replaces Hatchet Toss.

Wulferd Fizzbracket is a gnome located in Fizzsprings Resort in Tiragarde Sound. As Cataloger Wulferd, he appeared in the Trade District in Stormwind City, in attendance with Cataloguing Enthusiast and an Intrigued Dracthyr. After being recruited into the Dragonscale Expedition by the adventurer, he moved to Stormwind Harbor where he was seen trying to take a photo of a seagull from the pier. He is later seen in the Waking Shores.
Wynsen Jambolt is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Writings of Lycara is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wristwraps of the Shattered Abyss is a quest reward from Two Worthies.
Writhing Spaulders of Madness drop from Prophet Skitra in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
The Writhing Segment of Drest'agath drops from Drest'agath in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Wrist Wraps of the Zen Master is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Writhing Noose is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Writhing Shadow-Tendrils is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Wyrm's Shadowflame Crest Fragment drops from heroic Aberrus raid bosses and the end-of-run chest in a Mythic+ key in the 11–15 range. Combine fifteen to make a Wyrm's Shadowflame Crest, used to upgrade Dragonflight Season 2 items to item levels 428–437.

Wyrmtongue Cache of Magic drops from: *Chief Alchemist Munculus *Ven'orn *Gar'zoth *Watcher Aival *Lieutenant Xakaar *Vrax'thul *Zul'tan the Numerous *Umbraliss *Herald of Chaos *Captain Faruq *Soultwisted Monstrosity *Commander Xethgar *Kaara the Pale *Imp Mother Laglath *Tar Spitter *Commander Sathrenael *Siegemaster Voraan
Xen'Zilla is a jungle troll quest giver located at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Xavaric is a level 55 satyr found at Jadefire Run in northwestern Felwood. He is the leader of the Jadefire Satyrs and his minions feed from the fel corruption of the local creatures. Another Jadefire satyr, Xavathras, cultivates a Fel corrupted moonwell in the Ruins of Constellas on behalf of Xavaric. Xavaric carries a flute carved from an ancient protector. He is the namesake of Prydaz, Xavaric's Magnum Opus, which refers to the Flute made from the ancient protector.

Xavathras is a named satyr located at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood. He is the cruel leader of a group of Jadefire satyrs, who have made their home in tents amongst the Ruins of Constellas. Xavathras seeks to cultivate a corrupted moonwell on behalf of another cruel satyr, Xavaric. Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas wants Xavathras killed, in defense of Felwood.
Wyvern mounts (also known as "Wind Riders") are the standard flying mount form of the wyvern for the Horde. They come in a variety of colors, and run on all fours like a cat for land travel.

Xeleth is an observer that can be found in Zangarmarsh. He only appears after someone plants the Imbued Silver Spear into the Portal Clearing in western Zangarmarsh. This is done as the objective for the quest Against All Odds. Xeleth was once worshipped as a god by primitive swamp creatures in Zangarmarsh. When Draenor was nearly destroyed, he retreated into a slumber deep beneath Marshlight Lake. He wears a scar made by the Imbued Silver Spear, caused by the demon hunter Altruis the Sufferer.

The X-52 Nether Rocket is a huge rocket stationed on the middle of Area 52. B.O.O.M. engineers are currently working on it. There are a few quests involving it, such as killing nether rays for improving its fuel's blasting capability, stealing technology from Ethereals and protecting it from a giant fel reaver, Negatron. The X-52 Rocket Helmet was probably designed for allowing evacuation of the rocket under unfortunate or emergency conditions. Two smaller versions, the X-51 Nether-Rocket and X-51 Nether-Rocket X-TREME, have been created as personal mounts.

The X-51 Nether-Rocket is a piece of loot available from the trading card game set Servants of the Betrayer redeemable from in Booty Bay. The rocket functions as a flying mount that gives a 150% speed increase in air. You are able to buy the X-51 Nether-Rocket X-TREME once you have the appropriate riding skill.

XB-488 Disposalbots are part of the pre-XT-002 Deconstructor trash. They randomly target a raid member with Cut Scrap Metal, a channeled spell causing fire damage on a single target. When it reaches low health it will activate the ability Self Destruct, causing the bot to detonate and cause a very large amount of damage to players in the surrounding area. Take out these bots last. They are not very dangerous and the Self Destruct will only trigger when the bot is on very low health. The bot can be killed before it activates Self Destruct with focused DPS.

Xalan the Feared was the most successful general of the satyrs in Xavian during the War of the Satyr. A small party of night elves led a covert assault on Xavian and successfully assassinated him. The night elves also ripped Xalan's gloves from his hands, which were worn by Shandris Feathermoon.

Xuen the White Tiger is one of the four Wild Gods known as the August Celestials who dwell in Pandaria. Xuen watches over the Kun-Lai Summit from the Temple of the White Tiger and is sometimes referred to as the Northern Celestial. He is the spirit of strength. Xuen has two named children, Ban-Lu and Xu-Fu, and a granddaughter, Ban-Fu.
Xari the Kind is a representative of the Golden Lotus sent to the Shrine of Seven Stars to enlist Alliance aid.

Xhu'daggab was an observer that Ga'trul ordered his warlocks to summon, paranoid that the Alliance would strike unnoticed. He used the creature as a sentry, despite the protests of his fellow warlocks that the beast would be too powerful. When the Alliance attacked Twinspire Keep, where the creature was being held, they marked its prison with a flare and pilots bombed its location, allowing it to escape. Newly freed, Xhu'daggab began wreaking havoc on the keep. It is unknown what ultimately became of the creature.

Xing-Ho, Breath of Yu'lon is one of Wrathion's legendary cloak quest rewards for completing A Pandaren Legend in patch 5.4. It is the upgraded version of Jadefire Drape, created by using the Timeless Essence of the Black Dragonflight. Using the timeless essence will automatically upgrade the cloak to item level 136.
Xega is a pandaren located on the mountain ridge on the southeastern side of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra. He, along with Fara, is a member of Kanai Griffith's sketch group.
Xothear, the Destroyer is a wrathguard located at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Talador.

XR9-47 is a mechagnome located at Tomb of the Old Kings in Stormheim. He later appears at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain, in order to take delivery of parts from the Huntmaster for Mimiron's latest invention.

Xist, Spawn of Naraxas, is one of the three giant worms aiding the Mightstone drogbar during the battle of Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain. While fighting Xist, adventurers are aided by members of the Stonedark tribe.

__NOTOC__ Xaander is a draenei paladin and one of the five Unethical Adventurers that appear in a cave on the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain after a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure.

Xorias is a doomguard who escaped from imprisonment in a Soul Chamber and can now be found standing in a lava pool atop a ledge in the western part of Mucksnout Den in Highmountain. He is one of several demons which Apprentice Rosalyn asks adventurers to help her contain once again.
__NOTOC__ Xavinox is a satyr located at the Stormrage Barrow Dens in Moonglade. He can only be fought after Clookle has been cured.
The Xiwyllag ATV is a hovercraft mount. Kram Kelada on Mechagon Island can customize the colors of the mount.
X'oni was one of the most powerful druids to ever exist. Her mere presence was enough to cheer up her allies. Many of her tricks were learned from the legendary priest, Phyrix.

Xander's Gauntlets drop from the Unethical Adventurers that appear at the entrance of a Snowblind Mesa cave with suspicious signage in Highmountain when a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure.
__NOTOC__ Xue is a fire elemental summoned in Mardivas's Laboratory in Nazjatar. He is summoned by empowering a Lesser Pyroclastic Arcanocrystal and a Greater Benthic Arcanocrystal.
Xiln the Mountain is a mogu located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
__NOTOC__ Xorul the Insatiable is a devourer located on the floating island off the western edge of Korthia.
X'anshi, Return of Archbishop Benedictus is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Archbishop Benedictus.

Xalvez the Collector is a Maw caster who appears twice in the "The Last Sigil" chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign. He first appears during Let the Anima Flow, where he attacks the Maw Walker and Bonesmith Heirmir in the Caverns of Contemplation and teleports away at the last second when defeated. He reappears in Into the Vault, where he enters the Chamber of the Sigil accompanied by the Remnants of Kalvez and tries to claim the sigil of the Primus, before being killed for good by the Maw Walker and Heirmir. __NOTOC__
Xorothian Gauntlets drop from Lord Commander Alexius and Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
Xorothian Helmet drops from Lord Commander Alexius and Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.
Xorothian Pauldrons drop from Lord Commander Alexius and Fel Commander Erixtol in Highmountain.

Yetis are large, furry humanoid animals that usually live in or near caves. Some of the varieties in colder regions breathe ice breath. Yetis are skinnable, unlike most humanoids. Yetis can be found in Feralas, the Hillsbrad Foothills, Winterspring, and the Alterac Mountains. They can also be found in Northrend and Pandaria. Although generally regarded as untamed beasts, yetis are actually quite intelligent. The ones in Feralas, notably Feral Scar, utilize strategy in combat, name each other and even believe in an afterlife called the "Afterlands." Those in Feralas forged an alliance with the Woodpaw clan of gnolls, with the help of Aramar Thorne and his crew. Toejam the Terrible, in the Azu
Yellow Hakkari Bijou is a small token of power from the mobs in Zul'Gurub.

Yorba Screwspigot is a goblin located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Like most residents of Steamwheedle Port, she has gone missing and was possibly killed by the destructive wave that destroyed the port.

__NOTOC__ Yarzill the Merc is a quest giver located at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. Although he appears at first to be a run-of-the-mill goblin mercenary, he is in fact a nether dragon in disguise. Yarzill is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing. After completing Lord Illidan Stormrage (quest), Yarzill provides the player an escape from the enraged .

The Yellow Brewfest Stein can be filled at a Brewfest Festive Keg, becoming a , and then can be used to drink the brew. Filling, hence drinking, is free, and the brews are both alcoholic (inebriating) and provide mana restoration and a well fed buff. Obtaining it provided the Feat of Strength .

__NOTOC__ Yazmina Oakenthorn is a night elven member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. Kaldorei death knights have a chance to execute Oakenthorn. Her speech while the quest is in progress is arguably the saddest one can find in the game. The player, as a death knight, is ordered to end her life by a Scourge officer. Before blood is drawn, however, she mentions being the player's caretaker in his/her infancy, while his/her mother served at the Temple of the Moon. Realizing her life is forfeit, she orders the player to kill her, in the hopes of avoiding th

Yogg-Saron (pronounced yog-suh-RAWN) is one of the four Old Gods of Azeroth, mysterious and dread elder beings that were defeated and sequestered by the armies of the titans during the world's primordial ages. Upon its fall at the hands of the Pantheon countless millennia ago, Yogg-Saron was imprisoned inside the titan complex of Ulduar, within the depths of what would become the continent of Northrend. Yogg-Saron is responsible for many horrors suffered by Azeroth. In an attempt to escape its prison, the Old God corrupted the titan-forged keeper Loken and turned him against his own brethren, resulting in the death of Tyr, and

Ymirheim is an Ymirjar village in the center of the rift valley in Icecrown. The village sits high above most of the buildings of Icecrown, a ramshackle wooden vrykul village that wraps around a high mountain valley. At its center are the saronite mines mines of Icecrown; the village was likely put there to protect them. It is the most important place for the vrykul. The vrykul of Ymirheim are no ordinary tall and unpleasant people; they are the Ymirjar, the elite warrior caste created by King Ymiron in service of the Lich King, who won their battles in Valhalas. During the war against the Lich King, both the Horde and the Alliance were trying to assault this town by dropping infiltrators vi
Ymirjar Element Shapers are frost vrykul found in Ymirjar in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
Ymirheim Chosen Warriors are frost vrykul located in Ymirheim in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.

Ying Thunderspear is a pandaren found in the Path of Serenity in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He is speaking to Frostflower, Jonathan Le Karf, Zooey, and Kata Arina. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
__NOTOC__ Yedrin is a draenei flight master located at The Harborage, in the Swamp of Sorrows.
The Yellow Balloon is sold for by: * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar

Yaungolian Barbecue is an expansion feature achievement. To earn this achievement, players must prevent the village from being set alight during the Brewmoon Festival scenario. During Stage 2, Stage 3 and the Final Stage, players should be assigned to a spawn point to engage Yaungol warriors as soon as possible. This prevents them from throwing torches at the village buildings. When the Final Stage begins, Warbringer Qobi should be engaged and tanked outside the village. He should also be faced away so his fire lines do not run into the village.
Yalnu is the final boss of the Everbloom dungeon, fought at the Kirin Tor camp situated at the outskirts of Stormwind City.

Yong was a pandaren slave, who eventually decided his mogu masters could not have his obedience anymore and attacked them. As result Yong had been given a savage beating that had almost completely blinded him, leaving him only being able to make out vague shapes and shadows. He was eventually killed in order to test the capabilities of the huatang.
Y'mera's Arcanocrystal is provided as an objective for Conservation of Magic.
Yellow Eyes are beholder eyes that briefly spawn as a part of the Durumu the Forgotten encounter in the Throne of Thunder.
Yathae's Thumb Ring drops from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Yazmo the Loota is a jungle troll located on Mechagon Island.
Yellow Spineapples can be found on Island Expeditions. They heals adventurers to full health.

Yiphrim the Will Ravager is a k'thir located at Neferset City in Uldum. It has a chance to be spawned alongside two other rare elites (from a total pool of six) after enough players have completed the available summoning events in the area.
__NOTOC__ Yellow Junkhoppers are frogs located on Mechagon Island and in Operation: Mechagon.
Yergin Galvaquad is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island.
Yaz'za the Devourer is a toad located in Island Expeditions.
Yeti Mountain Basecamp was a planned subzone in Kun-Lai Summit.

Xy'teth is one of the broker assassins sent by Cartel Xy to kill Firim in Zereth Mortis, seen during Finding Firim. They are first seen on the road through the Great Veldt, having just killed Xevveth, but run away and disappear in a flash of magic before Pelagos and the Maw Walker can confront them. When the latter two reach Exile's Hollow, Xy'teth is lying dead at the entrance, killed by one of Firim's traps.

Ysera is the former Dragon Aspect of the green dragonflight, charged with keeping watch over the flowering wilds of Azeroth from within the Emerald Dream. Bound to this ethereal realm, she descended into an endless trance and became known thereafter as the Dreamer. She would later fight off the Emerald Nightmare and the corruption of her children. Ysera, now nicknamed the Awakened, recently awoke from her slumber within the Emerald Dream during the events of World of Warcraft: Cataclysm, though she was not yet able to consistently tell the difference between dream and reality; while she was still sane, she was not yet entirely coherent. Ysera aided the Guardians of Hyjal when the Twilight's
Young Chimaeras are chimaeras found at the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. Warriors seek them out to obtain Charred Horns.

Young Pridewings were wyverns found near Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Orcs supposedly collect and use these wyvern's deadly poisons, and the night elf Shindrell Swiftfire tasks Alliance adventurers to collect their Pridewing Venom Sacs, preventing the orcs from gathering their poison.

Young Arikara is a wind serpent that spawns briefly upon completion of the quest Alien Egg (quest) in the Thousand Needles. It then quickly disappears. The adult Arikara is summoned and fought in a later quest.
__NOTOC__ Yurial Soulwater is a blood elf enchanting vendor located on the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.
__NOTOC__ Yuula is a draenei quest giver located on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

Yulanini Hammersmith spent most of his life in a small clanhold on the shores of Loch Modan and traveled to Ironforge as a old man to petition the throne for assistance building a new aqueduct. While in the capital, he met members of the Explorers' Guild and was fascinated by their stories of adventure and faraway places. Though he soon realized that he was too old to set out as an explorer, he found through delivering his petition that he had theretofore undiscovered diplomatic abilities and offered his skills to the Guild. Today, he is the liaison between the Excursion Council and King Magni Bronzebeard, ensuring that the Guild stays in the throne's good graces.
Ysera's Tears are located on Wyrmscar Island of Bloodmyst Isle.

Your Continued Support is part of the Shattered Sun Offensive storyline. Once players have funded the construction of the Monument to the Fallen, this quest replaces A Charitable Donation. Players who are with the Offensive will not see this quest.
You're So Offensive is awarded when one reaches status with the Shattered Sun Offensive.
Yuma Ironkettle is a pandaren located by Shing Lightningpaw in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Yowler's Den is the base of Yowler, son of Yowler. It is found at the northern end of the Redridge Canyons north of Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.

You Have Been Rylakinated! is an achievement earned from killing 10 Darkwing Adolescents within 3 minutes while driving a Rylakinator-3000 in Darktide Roost, . This can only be completed while on the associated garrison daily, or after completing the Dirty Rats stage of the Garrison Campaign story, and one must also possess a Rylakinator-3000 Power Cell to operate the machinery. The timer begins once you jump into the Rylakinator-3000, so be quick to act at this point.

You Can't Make a Giant Omelette... is an achievement earned from breaking the Giant Rylak Egg in Darktide Roost, . The egg is located atop the highest peak on the isle , and the main way to get up there is by using Goblin Rocket Packs looted off the goblins below. Quicker ways involve using Aviana's Feather and falling near it, or by simply flying there providing it's unlocked.

Yotnar is a titanic watcher located in Stormheim. He is the keeper of the Vault of Aggramar and the objective of the Trial of Might, one of the three trials required to gain access to the Halls of Valor and claim the mythic :Aegis of Aggramar. When God-King Skovald completed his trial, he used his ill-begotten powers to sunder Yotnar's physical body, enter the Vault, and gain knowledge of the other trials without the watcher's blessing. A champion would however retrieve Yotnar's pieces and make him whole again, before gaining his blessing and passing the trial.

__NOTOC__ Yseralline Seeds are gathered from the following herb nodes: * Aethril in Azsuna * Dreamleaf in Val'sharah * Fjarnskaggl in Stormheim * Foxflower in Highmountain It can also be gathered from nearly all plant-type mobs in Val'sharah.

:This fish-apple soup may sound like an acquired taste, but we assure you, it's a delectable and filling meal after a nice long hike through the lush green mountains of Pandaria. A word of warning, though: "Never touch a hozen's Yu-Ping Soup! Yu-Ping Soup is provided as an objective for A Gift For Sho.
Yrel's Command is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
Young Pallo is a vision of tauren located in Highmountain. He appears upon interacting with the Ancient Spirit Drum.
Young Sourbacks are saurolisks located in Sourback Hideout at the Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.
Yunhwan Grapplebottle is a goblin located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Yurik Fingersprings is a goblin located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
You Can Pet the Dog, But... is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Shad'har the Insatiable in Ny'alotha, the Waking City after having everyone /pet him.
Young Wildclaws are wilderlings flying above the bottom level of the Glitterfall Heights and the immediate surroundings of Glitterfall Basin in Ardenweald.
Yu'lon's Whisper is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Yu'lon.
You Got the Beat is a world event achievement earned by getting a perfect score in the Darkmoon Faire Dance game on the easiest difficulty.
Young Snowfeathers are falcosaurs located at Misty Coast in Highmountain.
Yu'lon's Grace is a monk class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Diffuse Magic.
The Zandalar Predator's Belt is a quest reward from Paragons of Power: The Predator's Belt.
The Zandalar Predator's Mantle is a quest reward from Paragons of Power: The Predator's Mantle.
The Zandalar Predator's Bracers are a quest reward from Paragons of Power: The Predator's Bracers.
Zandalar Freethinker's Armguards are a quest reward from Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Armguards.
Zandalar Freethinker's Breastplate was a quest reward from Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate.
Zandalar Vindicator's Breastplate is a quest reward from Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Breastplate.

__NOTOC__ Zachariah Post is a Forsaken skeletal horse vendor located in Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Following the Battle for Lordaeron, he is located on the Gates of Orgrimmar in Orgrimmar. After the Forsaken started rebuilding Brill, he and his horses returned there. Once the undead reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, Zachariah relocated to the city.

Zabra'jin is a large Horde-aligned troll town in Zangarmarsh with huts connecting to a few mushrooms and wood planks holding the other buildings above the marsh. There is a flight path located here as well as a forge. It is possibly named after the troll priest Zabra Hexx.

Zaetar's Grave is the final area of Maraudon, south of Earth Song Falls. Guarded by mountain giants and located at the top of a waterfall, this is the resting place of Zaetar, the father of the centaur race, and is roamed by his lover Princess Theradras. The life energies permeating Zaetar's body has turned the area into a verdant paradise of plant life and tranquil water. Defeating Theradras will set Zaetar's Spirit free. The body of water below the grave is patrolled by Rotgrip and Thessala Hydras.

Zaj'tal was a naga spellcaster. He once attacked and defeated a night elf sentry guarding an Alliance encampment, claiming he would disfigure the sentry's face and enjoy doing so. Later, while searching for a scepter, Zaj'tal has his minions destroy a night elf village. He then battles a pandaren wardancer, Shinjo Greatpaw, who had friends in that village.
Zaman was located on an island southeast of Hetaera's Clutch in Azshara. It was the pet of Loramus Thalipedes, along with Raytaf and Shahiar.
Zaetar's Deathshroud drops from Crown Princess Theradras after successfully defending a major city during phase 4 of the Elemental Unrest.
Zandalari Archons are Zandalari trolls found in both Zul'Aman and Zul'Gurub. They're part of the Zandalar efforts to help rebuild and strengthen their cousins.
Zandalari Hierophants are Zandalari trolls found in both Zul'Aman and Zul'Gurub. They're part of the Zandalar efforts to help rebuild and strengthen their cousins.
Zandalari Juggernauts are Zandalari trolls found in both Zul'Aman and Zul'Gurub. They're part of the Zandalar efforts to help rebuild and strengthen their cousins.
Zan'vess is a kypari tree that lies offshore of southwestern Dread Wastes across the Briny Muck. The Amber Quarry and the Whispering Stones are on the southern side of the island.
__NOTOC__ Zaldaan is a draenei flight master located at Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle.

Zai the Outcast is a rare jinyu found east of Inkgill Mere in the Kun-Lai Summit. A notable drop is the Farwater Conch, an item that allows the user to see far into the distance and grants the ability to create water droplets. Zai is a pandarian champion.
__NOTOC__ Four Zandalari Arcweavers are seen channeling magic into Tormented Skyscreamers in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder. They are also in the Troves of the Thunder King.
__NOTOC__ Zaari is a draenei flight master located at Anchorite's Sojourn in Talador.

Zan'non was a Gurubashi jungle troll who took up control of the Gurubashi tribes following his father Jok'non's death around 18 years prior to the opening of the Dark Portal. None of the Gurubashi who had witnessed Jok'non's death at the hands of Medivh had survived, but it took little imagination for the trolls to guess who was responsible. They soon rallied under Zan'non's banner and marched to war against Stormwind, marking the beginning of the Gurubashi War. When the trolls arrived at the walls of Stormwind City, the human soldiers trembled at their numbers. Zabar is a Zandalari troll flight master located at Zul'jan Ruins in Nazmir.

Zandalari Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Zandalari archaeology sites.
The Zanchuli Cuffs are a quest reward from Show of Strength.
Zanchuli Acolytes are Zandalari troll bloodcasting acolytes located in Dazar'alor. Some of them turn into cultists using blood magic.
Zal'zi the Bloodgorged is a vampire bat located in Island Expedition.
Zaliz' Eternal Hound is a quilen located in Island Expeditions.
Zan'thik Drones are mantid found flying around in large numbers during the Assault on Zan'vess.
__NOTOC__ Zaa'je is a jungle troll found in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He is in charge of workers who built and maintain the Trading Post.

Zardeth of the Black Claw is a human quest giver located in the Slaughtered Lamb within the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. As Lord Baurles K. Wishock was made aware of the warlocks' establishment, he was lobbying for a full investigation on them. Zardeth had a plan to keep him "preoccupied". He asked an Alliance adventurer to gather a flower growing in the garden of Stalvan on the outskirts of Darkshire, called the :Tear of Tilloa, as well as a :Musquash Root found at the base of the falls far beneath the Stonewrought Dam in the Wetlands. When Zardeth received the samples, he created a special brew for him, :Black Claw Stout, and had it delivered to him, as he knew that Wishock liked liquor

Zarlman Two-Moons is a tauren quest giver located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. While Baine Bloodhoof takes care of village matters in the physical world, Zarlman looks after the village in the spiritual world.
__NOTOC__ Zapetta is a goblin zeppelin master located in the zeppelin tower just north of the Undercity gates in Tirisfal Glades. He gives information about Durotar.

Zanza's Rise was a subregion of Zul'Gurub, just past the left fork of the first crossroads after the Coil. This was where Zanza the Restless could be found, gazing sadly out over the fallen temple city.
Zandras is a satyr found at the Warden's Cage in Shadowmoon Valley.

Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, it is meant to show a player the most efficient way to complete all quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired). For major changes, feel free to edit, but make a note in the talk page as to your reasoning.
Zazzix Boomride is a goblin flight master located on Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles. Tilly Topspin is his Alliance counterpart.

Zao Sunseeker is a literary pandaren found in Scrollkeeper's Sanctum in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. He has been brought to life by the destruction of the Corrupted Scroll. The legend says that when the five suns started to do damages to the lands, Zao was the one to eliminate them. In the library, he starts shooting the suns while helping the players. After the suns are destroyed, he becomes corrupted by Sha of Doubt and tries to kill the players that he describes as "mirages".
Zandalari Terror Riders are jungle trolls found flying Zandalari Pterrorwings around Mogu'shan Vaults. They are a part of the Zandalari Invaders group.

The Zangar Sea (also known as the Sea of Zangar) is the name of the sea that lies between Frostfire Ridge and on central . Seemingly having a mind of its own, it seeks to overtake the land by releasing thousands of spores and slowly growing inland over time. The sea, and thus the Zangar encroachment, was created from the rotting body of the Sporemound Zang. During the war in Draenor, the Horde set up a naval blockade around the sea in order to protect their garrison. In the main timeline, marshes covered in fungi existed along the coast. Zappy Zooly is a gnome found just outside Andromath's Rise in Stormshield. He maintains a portal to Stormwind City.

Zargrom is a mo'arg brute that appeared at the Legion Invasion locations. He also appears in Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
Zar'vok is a doomguard that appears in Highmountain during a Legion Assault. He previously appeared at Legion Invasion locations.

Zang was the smallest of the three final Sporemounds faced by Grond, the other two being Naanu and Botaan. Its hide was covered in swampy mires and mushroom thickets. As the smallest of the Sporemounds, Zang suffered the most at Grond's onslaught and was the first to fall. Grond took hold of Zang and tore the monstrous creature in half, and its shredded corpse toppled to the world's surface with a deafening thunderclap. In the ages to come, its rotting body would transform into a fungal region known as the Zangar Sea. The Zandalari army (or the armies of Zandalar) is one of the principal military wings of the armed forces of the Zandalari Empire along with the forces in the Golden Fleet. The army has been an integral part of the survival of the empire throughout the many events following the Cataclysm. Historically, the army has been based from Zuldazar, and has been deployed to a great many areas across Azeroth. Their forces served in the continents of the Eastern Kingdoms and Pandaria, as part of the war against the Zandalari.

The Zara'thik swarm of mantid is located on Molten Cay. They are the elite guard of the mantid empress. After N'Zoth was freed and began assaulting Azeroth, the Zara'thik returned to Pandaria. Empowered with azerite they plundered on the Molten Cay, the Zara'thik assaulted the Vale of Eternal Blossoms as part of N'Zoth's forces. They will stop at nothing short of absolute conquest of all of Pandaria.
The Zann'esu clan of vrykul mages lived in Brunnhildar Village. They went in search of the perfect magic to defeat the Lich King, but never returned.
__NOTOC__ Zanj'ir Destroyers are naga brutes located in Nazjatar.
The Zapblast Bots are a pair of crowd pummelers working at Torben Zapblast's camp on the northern part of Duskfall Island in Talador.
Zandle is a tortollan that briefly appears in Seekers' Vista in Stormsong Valley during the completion of Battle Victorious and Turtle Tactics.
Zeal of the Aspirant is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Zatojin is a vespoid found flying above Zovaal's Grasp in Zereth Mortis. While not immediately attackable, a group of dead Scarabid Burrowers provide clues to how to coax this bug within range. Nearby Menacing Vespoid Workers are found to have a paralytic poison sting. With 20 stacks of their debuffs, the adventurer will be paralyzed for a few moments, and Zatojin will descend.

They do not have any openings or handouts, and their path is the elite, taking only those gifted from birth with prowess in battle and gifted by the loa, and crafting champions of light to defend the Zandalari Empire. As such, they are a part of the faithful with the troll priests and druids, and therefore, among the most revered in Zandalari society. Zaqali Caldera is the western anchor of Zaralek Cavern. An elite area with anti-flight measures in place, the caldera is the source of the lava that feeds Aberrus. Players quest through the caldera during chapter three of the Embers of Neltharion campaign: "The Ancient Bargain", where they encounter Fyrakk, the Primal Incarnate of fire, in the flesh. The Zaqali Elders world boss encounter takes place at at the western end of the caldera, and rare elites Emberdusk, Flowfy, Jrumm, Skornace, and Subterrax also spawn in and around the caldera. Players can also find a Dragon Glyph at above a rock outcrop overlooking the caldera proper. Additionally, public objectives Conspiracy of Flames, Imperfe

.]] .]] Zeppelins are flying contraptions created by the goblins, using a lighter-than-air design, with their machines employing bags filled with gas to make them buoyant in the air, compared to heavier-than-air designs, which employ wing surfaces and movement to produce lift, either using a fixed wing, or a spinning rotor. A goblin zeppelin consists of a gondola of varying size suspended beneath one or more bags of lightweight gas that serve to keep the craft aloft. In keeping with the goblin fixation upon profit, these large crafts tend to be packed with cargo or paying passengers.

.]] Zhevra are striped unicorn- or -like beasts that are found in the Barrens. They are normally and may not be the strongest of beasts in the Barrens, but stay clear of their kick or you'll regret it. Zhevras hold a lot of strength in their legs and can even knock a tauren on its haunches. Zhevras are rarely used as mounts in Azeroth due to their stubborn nature and tendency to bite. The nightborne classify zhevra as unicorns; or rather, as monohorns, which they claim is a much more fitting name.

Zethresh is a naga warlord. Rumors abound that a large naga force, under a warlord called Zethresh, hides near Crestfall's west shore. Zethresh reputedly seeks to cleanse the ocean and her isles of human encroachment.
Zereketh the Unbound is a powerful voidwraith and the first boss of the Arcatraz in Tempest Keep.

.]] stronghold in Zeth'Gor.]] Zeth'Gor is a ruined orc base in the mountains of southeastern Hellfire Peninsula, with a stronghold (also identified as barracks), a kennel and damaged hovels. It is now overrun with fel orcs of the Bleeding Hollow clan. There is also a fel orc called Warlord Morkh inside the stronghold. When you slay him, a huge, green eye (the Eye of the Citadel, probably Broggok) spawns and promises to meet you in Hellfire Citadel.

__NOTOC__ Zeb'Sora is a small Shadowpine forest troll village located on the east shore of Lake Elrendar in the northeastern Ghostlands, just south of the border with the Eversong Woods and just north of Dawnstar Spire. Lieutenant Tomathren of the Farstriders led a poorly conceived attack on the village that resulted in the loss of many rangers, though Tomathren himself claims that the whole thing was Ranger Valanna's fault and that the attack would've worked if the rangers had only done as he'd told them.
Zggi is an imp found beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind City.

The most popular of the recreations of Zecker's devices that have started to appear in recent years are those of his "wand of stunning", Zecker's Wand. Though slightly thicker then normal, it is to all other outward appearances a finely crafted magical wand with a sizeable quartz crystal affixed to its tip. Hidden among the brasswork that wraps around the wand's shaft is a small catch. When the catch is triggered, a small piston inside the wand sprays a 10-foot cone of poisonous vapor. The wand holds enough poison for three uses, after which a new charge must be obtained from an alchemist.
__NOTOC__ Zendarin Windrunner was the blood elf cousin of the Windrunner sisters, who allied himself with the black dragon Sinestra in an attempt to create the twilight dragonflight.
Zeptek the Destroyer is a proto-dragon located in Sholazar Basin. He is Warlord Tartek's mount.
Zem Leeward is a human standing with a fishing pole, near the fishing trainer on one of the docks in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.

Zen'Balai is a jungle troll druid trainer located in Nighthaven in Moonglade. Before the Cataclysm, she lived in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. She appeared in the Dreamgrove during the third invasion of the Burning Legion.
Zen Sphere is a talented monk ability, available at level 30.
Zhen Zhen Wang is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Zergling Rush is an ability used only by Zergling during a Pet Battle.

Zhahara Darksquall was a naga assigned by her superiors to find the lost continent of Pandaria. However, Zhahara herself was obsessed with finding the Wandering Isle and the Pearl of Pandaria. To aid her, Zhahara enlisted the help of Rahjak, Blokk, and Rumblefitz.
Zelaji is the Horde Monk Leader in Warspear Outpost, Ashran. He serves to teleport players to the location of their current party leader.

Zertin is one of the dark shaman left behind by Garrosh Hellscream on Pandaria after the destruction of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He along with the other shaman were tracking down their leader who had been captured and ended up at Mudclaw residence. Before attacking, the shaman were interrupted by virmen to which Zertin killed their leader. He was able to distract the defenders and help Mashok escape. Like the other shaman, he fell and died while Lyalia stabbed him with her moonglaive.
Zerpy Clampshock is a goblin vendor located at the Shattered Landing in Blasted Lands.

__NOTOC__ Zenobia is a high elf priest and one of the five Unethical Adventurers that appear in a cave on the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain after a player attempts to loot the Seemingly Unguarded Treasure.

Zi'mo the Empowered is a jungle troll mage of the Tirisgarde located in the Hall of the Guardian. He later traveled to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. He is accompanied by Da Righteous Voodoo and King Blastakhan.
Zeth'jir Shatterers are naga located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Zena the Feeder is a Zandalari troll flight master located at the Sliver in Dazar'alor. She is found standing with a group of Screaming Pterrordax.
